title: SAN Check
description: CoC-inspired POW, hidden SAN checks, and player hallucination pressure for DnD Six Attributes.
body:
# SAN Check

SAN Check is an addon for DnD Six Attributes. It focuses on hidden SAN pressure, visible status warnings, and CoC-inspired POW checks.

![SAN Check hallucinating status](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/AJpB7ytL/images/7153a9bc14206b20a9bcdde099899ea5a065f557_350.webp)

## Features

- Adds **POW / Will** as an addon attribute for DnD Six Attributes.
- Maps the 0–20 attribute scale to CoC-style percent POW with `POW × 5`.
- Resets hidden SAN to `POW × 5` when a player respawns.
- Shows status-effect icons when SAN loss or hallucination is active.
- Reduces or increases vanilla mental-effect durations based on POW.
- Adds SAN checks for selected stressful events.

## SAN checks

SAN loss chance is `1 - POW_percent / 100`.

- Taking mob damage while standing in a vanilla monster-spawnable position: `0/1`.
- Angering an Enderman: `1/1d4`.
- Witnessing another player die nearby: `0/1d10`.

## Hallucinations

- SAN below 50 starts hallucination pressure.
- SAN 0 reaches 100% hallucination chance.
- A single SAN loss of 5 or more triggers a temporary 50% hallucination chance for `10 × 1d10` seconds.
- Hallucinations target other players only, not friendly animals or villagers.

## Dependency

Requires DnD Six Attributes.
